rationale: Create one canonical ACL Airshop company and one active Astatine Investment Partners ownership period linked to Alinda Infrastructure Fund IV. Alinda-managed funds completed the acquisition in April 2021, and a January 2023 prospectus identifies ACL as an AF4 investment with a 100% AF4 equity interest. Alinda's April 2022 rename to Astatine was a manager rebrand rather than a sale. Astatine's live portfolio page marks ACL Active and its March 2026 release still calls ACL a portfolio company of Astatine-managed funds. No later sale, recapitalization, merger, sponsor change or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 17, 2026. Count the global ACL Airshop platform once and exclude predecessor names, airport stations, fleets, repair sites, software, products and customers as separate PortCos.

afterImage.name: ACL Airshop
afterImage.subsector: Air cargo ULD leasing and logistics infrastructure
afterImage.description: ACL Airshop is a global air-cargo unit load device platform that leases, pools, sells, repairs, tracks and manages ULDs and supplies pallets, containers, nets, straps and related cargo-control equipment. Headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina, the company served more than 200 airlines, air-cargo carriers and other transportation clients and owned, maintained or managed more than 100,000 ULDs across 55 airport hubs as of March 2026. The business was founded as Airline Container Leasing in 1983 and its successor operations merged with AirShop Holdings in 2007. Alinda-managed funds completed the acquisition in April 2021; the manager renamed its mid-market infrastructure strategy Astatine Investment Partners in 2022. A January 2023 prospectus states that Alinda Infrastructure Fund IV held a 100% equity interest, while current Astatine sources reaffirm ownership without restating the percentage. No later sale, recapitalization, merger, sponsor change or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 17, 2026. Airport stations, ULD fleets, repair sites, software and products are operations or assets within ACL Airshop, not separate PortCos.
